notes: Independent C7 critic, round3. Verdict is fail despite substantial repairs. Read BRIEF-17 in full, both panel briefs, NOTES method/current C7 sections, COURSE.md and all five cycle-7 reviews/FIXES. The latest coordinator structure requirements take precedence over any concept that disagrees; specifically a drawn south-facing market or omitted wall lane is not a waiver. No art was drawn or modified by this review. Scope: all126 production PNGs named by r17-C7-QC.json were inspected at native1x and nearest-neighbour4x, plus all three1920×1440 concepts and the current city/required comparisons/crops. Complete city4x coverage is saved as sixteen native-crop enlargements; selected joins, signs and market edges were also inspected at8x. Ground and roof-fill repeats were literal3×3. Small props were checked over summer grass, city paving and autumn/winter/spring grass. C7 defines no seasonal partner exports, so there are zero C7 summer/season alpha-pair comparisons to perform; all923 pre-existing seasonal PNG hashes still match the supplied baseline. Independent mechanical checks: all126 current production hashes match the QC snapshot; all have only0/255 alpha and zero RGB under transparency; recorded dimensions match; every C7 ground/storey row0/47 matches COURSE.md exactly. The final is1920×1440; its2x is pixel-exact nearest-neighbour, squint is the exact grayscale conversion, and all three3x crops match the specified native rectangles. These mechanical passes do not override the visual failures. Repairs accepted: real nine-block/107-lot ownership, wall-line towers rather than street towers, a coherent whole gatehouse with attached stair, complete market roof, restored course rows, readable uncut trade glyphs, the NW laundry rack and NE sorting table, low peripheral storeys, quieter curtain joins and improved directional shade. The final now clearly resembles concept B’s street plan. The remaining failure is not a claim that the plan is unrelated to the concept; it is the listed structure, roof/material coherence, entrance, mounting and hierarchy defects. Outstanding FIXES are principally2 (real width variation),4/5/11 (roof and receiving construction/material scale),6 (north-facing market entrance),9 (window-clear sign mounting),12 (integrated gate-turn paving),14 (continuous inner wall lane),15 (remaining narrow cap/wing treatment), and20 (acceptance/access proofs). The old course, clipped-tailor-sign and roofless-market complaints have not been repeated as current defects. Legacy block-civic/block-nw/block-ne/etc PNGs that are not used as whole sprites by the present composer are assessed as individual drawings; defects in the current reconstructed city are assigned to compose.py and the final, not incorrectly attributed to those unused older drawings. block-inn-b, block-market and block-se are current reconstructed exports and are assessed accordingly. Evidence is in critic-r17C7-3-*.png. No runtime collision correctness is claimed. Only review files under art-drop/review were written; production art, compose.py, NOTES, branches and git history were left unchanged.
